registered_before: any mutate8 run on v8 bytes (the WIP counter at registration was still a byte copy of frozen v7, sha256 59c9930ae864ce826e9f468b4b76bdef33de7ae5e6760eda4d88db4eab2e8548)
notes: del-leg entries delete the leg's decision (assignment in evaluate or checks-dict entry); one per new leg. The harness fails closed if a leg is absent from the counter or has no derived del-leg site.

mut-const entries replace one literal of the c14r99 profile; the find string must occur exactly once in the pinned counter source, else the harness exits 2 (PREREG_FAIL). Find strings use the kwarg spelling the v7 c14 profile uses (VOTES_DIR="..." inside configure()).

Kill expectation (predicted before any v8 run): every del-leg of a new leg is killed by the honest c14r99 self-test fixture and by the do-nothing tree (the leg is undecided, the verdict set changes). mut-const flips are expected to be killed by the self-test honest c14r99 fixture (wrong votes dir / registry / freeze / pinned seats make the honest fixture fail). A mut-const that survives BOTH detectors is reported as a v8 coverage finding, not a harness failure.

mutants.desc: c14r99 votes dir pointed at the round-98 votes
c14r99 registry pointed at the round-98 registry
c14r99 freeze rev swapped to the round-98 freeze
c14r99 pinned role of ExecCounterV8 swapped executor->scout
c14r99 pinned role of CriticR99 swapped critic->reviewer
